verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no first-party or partner connector catalog for SaaS apps, databases, or ETL/ELT tools. What it does show earns no credit for this story: native ClickHouse protocol compatibility so existing clients connect unchanged is an inherited compatibility claim, not a connector; the BI tools listed (Grafana, Metabase, Tableau) consume data rather than ingest it; and the object-storage path from self-managed ClickHouse is a migration procedure, not a source connector.
